text: Is Kyriba ready to go live, or what control evidence is still open?
claudePromptBoundary: Full production prompt is reconstructed from current source template and captured source packet. ai_egress_audit stores prompt hash/snapshot refs, not raw prompt text by default.
claudeResponse:
Lakeshore Holdings has a clear answer here: Kyriba is not ready to go live. Two SOX-domain controls are blocking, and a high-severity RAID issue confirms the gap is actively tracked and open. The loaded tenant evidence shows three specific items that must close before go-live.
First, the SAP-Kyriba interface reconciliation control (LAK CTRL, SOX domain, Controller-owned) is flagged missing machine-readable evidence — the requirement is to attach test and signoff source before go-live. Second, the close evidence retention control (LAK CTRL, SOX domain, CFO-owned) carries the identical status: missing machine-readable evidence, same gate condition.
Third, the RAID log carries an open high-severity, high-likelihood issue — "SOX payment and signer controls evidence incomplete for go-live" — with a due date of 2026-09-15 and a mitigation path of building a signer matrix, linking controls to source, and closing audit gaps.
The one control that is not blocking is Kyriba role design (identity/access domain, CIO-owned), which shows source available and is on standard review cadence. That one is not the bottleneck. The commercial dimension adds urgency. Kyriba is a $950K/yr enterprise subscription, renewal 2026-07-06, owned by the CFO, rated high criticality.
" Going live without closing the SOX controls exposes Lakeshore to audit findings against a contract that is already renewing this summer.
The decision the Controller and CFO need to make right now is whether the signer matrix and machine-readable evidence can be completed before the July renewal date, or whether go-live should be scoped to non-SOX workflows first while the two blocking controls are remediated.
Running a phased go-live — payment visibility and reporting now, SOX payment approvals after the evidence gate closes — is a common way to avoid both audit exposure and a delayed go-live on an already-live $950K contract.
--- Kyriba Go-Live Control Evidence — Open Items | Risk / Control | Control ID | Domain | Severity | Status | Gap Condition | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SAP-Kyriba interface reconciliation | LAK CTRL | SOX | Medium | Missing machine-readable evidence | Attach test/signoff source before go-live | Controller | Before go-live |
| Close evidence retention | LAK CTRL | SOX | Medium | Missing machine-readable evidence | Attach test/signoff source before go-live | CFO | Before go-live |
| SOX payment & signer controls (RAID) | LAKESHORE RAID | SOX | High | Open | Evidence signer matrix; link controls to source; close audit gaps | Controller | 2026-09-15 |
| Kyriba role design | LAK CTRL | Identity / Access | Medium | Source available | Standard review cadence — not blocking | CIO | Ongoing | The most useful next action is a joint Controller-CFO working session to scope the signer matrix and confirm whether machine-readable test evidence can be produced before the July 6 renewal.
If it cannot, a phased go-live scope should be agreed in writing before that date.
